scope: A bounded macOS sampling profile of the unchanged exact Rust child during the existing 128-polygon transport benchmark. This identifies hot stacks, not a causal speedup or a certificate result.
limitations: The child finished before the requested two-second sample duration; the sample contains startup and idle stacks and is not a calibrated CPU-time breakdown.
Coverage includes exact clipping, area accumulation, rational normalization, and allocation; sampled symbols alone cannot assign the observed Python/Rust wall difference to one operation.
Sampling perturbed this transport benchmark. Use the unsampled retained transport receipt for batching ratios and the retained matched receipt for verifier wall comparisons.
